title: A Little Sky for a Journey
paras: Mina makes small travel bags in a shop near the sea. She cuts the cloth and paints each bag by hand. Her bags are [[blue|blue]], like the sky above her town. People can see her work on the [[internet|internet]], but many come to her shop. They like to watch her paint.

It is [[february|February]], and the town is quiet. One morning, an [[actor|actor]] called Pavel arrives in a [[taxi|taxi]]. He needs a bag for a long trip. He shows Mina a photo of the night sky. There is one bright [[star|star]] above a small white house. It is his mother's home.

Mina puts the photo beside her paint. She makes a white house on the bag, then adds a yellow point above it. Pavel sits by the window and watches. For Mina, [[art|art]] can help people carry a little of home. She also makes a small pocket inside. “Put [[your|your]] keys here,” she says. “Then you will not [[lose|lose]] them.”

Pavel needs to leave [[tonight|tonight]], so Mina works until five. Then she gives him the finished bag. He puts his keys in the pocket and smiles at the little house. Outside, the sky is getting dark. Mina stands at her door as he leaves. Her little painted sky is ready to travel with him.
zh: 米娜在海边的一家小店里制作小旅行包。她裁好布，再亲手在每个包上画画。她做的包是蓝色的，就像小镇上方的天空。人们可以在互联网上看到她的作品，但许多人还是会来到店里。他们喜欢看她画画。
现在是二月，小镇很安静。一天早上，一位名叫帕维尔的演员乘出租车来到这里。他要出一趟远门，需要一个包。他给米娜看了一张夜空的照片。一座白色小屋上方有一颗明亮的星星。那是他母亲的家。
米娜把照片放在颜料旁边。她在包上画了一座白色小屋，又在上方点上一个黄色的点。帕维尔坐在窗边看着。对米娜来说，艺术能让人们随身带着一点家的感觉。她还在包里做了一个小口袋。她说：“把你的钥匙放在这里，这样就不会弄丢了。”
帕维尔今晚就要走，所以米娜一直忙到五点。然后，她把做好的包交给他。他把钥匙放进口袋，看着那座小屋笑了。外面的天色渐渐暗下来。他离开时，米娜站在店门口。她画的那片小小天空，已经准备好陪他一起旅行了。

q.s: Mina paints each travel bag by hand.
q.why: 文中明确说她亲手在每个包上画画。
帕维尔是乘出租车来的。

q.s: Pavel buys a second bag for his mother.
q.why: 文中未提到他给母亲另买一个包。
